There is a paper label on the face with handwritten text in black ink. The image shows significant grain/noise and some blur, typical of older film photography or low-light digital capture.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten text on the label is largely illegible and morphologically inconsistent. Characters blend into each other, and some strokes do not form recognizable letters, suggesting AI difficulty in rendering coherent handwriting rather than just poor penmanship.

The image has a heavy, uniform noise/grain pattern that feels slightly artificial or overly applied, potentially masking subtle generation artifacts. The plastic texture lacks the sharp specular highlights expected of smooth polycarbonate, appearing somewhat muddy.

The molded details at the very bottom edge appear slightly soft and ill-defined, lacking the crisp geometric precision of real injection molding, though this could also be attributed to depth-of-field blur.
